strategy: Prioritize moving toward the goal when safe, avoid obstacles, and stop if all directions are blocked.
decisions: If goal_ahead is true and front_blocked is false, then FORWARD.
If goal_on_left is true and left_blocked is false, then LEFT.
If goal_on_right is true and right_blocked is false, then RIGHT.
If front_blocked is true and left_blocked is false, then LEFT.
If front_blocked is true and right_blocked is false, then RIGHT.
If front_blocked is true and left_blocked is true and right_blocked is true, then STOP.
stop_condition: When front_blocked, left_blocked, and right_blocked are all true.
